#include <iostream>
#include <string>

class WordCounter {
public:
    bool paren = false;
    int max = 0;
    int count = 0;
    int temp = 0;

    void process(char c) {
        if (c == '_') {
            if (paren && temp != 0) {
                count++;
            } else if (temp > max) {
                max = temp;
            }
            temp = 0;
        } else if (c == '(') {
            paren = true;
            if (temp > max) {
                max = temp;
            }
            temp = 0;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            paren = false;
            if (temp > 0) {
                count++;
            }
            temp = 0;
        } else {
            temp++;
        }
    }

    void finish() {
        if (temp > max) {
            max = temp;
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string a;
    std::cin >> n >> a;

    WordCounter wc;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        wc.process(a[i]);
    }
    wc.finish();

    std::cout << wc.max << " " << wc.count << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
